name: Token Management
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
    *   Task: Summarize a cluster of updates into a cohesive release note entry.
    *   Target Audience: Enthusiastic Retailer (cares about improvements/new features).
    *   Style Guide:
        *   Simple, active voice, granular but concise.
        *   New Features/Enhancements structure: Problem, Solution, Impact.
        *   Bug Fixes structure: "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]."
        *   Tone: Professional, utility-focused.
        *   Prohibited Words ("AI Slop"): "enhanced", "streamlined", "seamless", "robust".
        *   No Exclamation Points.
        *   No "dev-time bugs" in features (though this looks like a bug fix).
        *   True Bug Fixes: Start with "Fixed a bug..." and focus on user-visible symptoms.
    *   Input: A cluster of PRs/Issues related to FCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) token removal during logout.

    *   Issue #807 (BOPIS): FCM token removal happens *post-logout*. This causes authorization errors because once the user logs out, the API calls to remove the token fail. Symptom: Logout gets stuck and errors in console.
    *   PR #808 (BOPIS): Moves token removal
